knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A fault that cleaning cannot fix, and that holds soil, is a maintenance matter that may create an infection control risk.
The request needs enough detail to be actioned and prioritised, which means item, location, risk and date.
A written boundary with a named owner prevents disputes and gaps between cleaning and maintenance.
The time frames follow risk section says findings in the highest risk areas are to be acted on immediately, with the cleaning kept constant.

practicalCriteria: Learner sorts five sample findings into cleaning or maintenance, with at least four correct
Learner writes one maintenance request for a sample fault with item, location, risk and date, all four present
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sorted sample list signed by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Fault involves electrical or structural hazard
A maintenance request cannot be lodged and the area is in use by patients
